title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1999 16.3.2 On the basis of Police Strength (Civil + Armed), the comparative rate of complaints per 100 Policemen is obtained from each State/UT and is presented below. Delhi UT reported 40.2 complaints per 100 Policemen followed by Madhya Pradesh 22.9 as against national average of 5.6 during the year. Interestingly, the number of complaints which turned out to be false, or un-sustained in Delhi were only 0.4 complaints per 100 Police Personnel as against the national level average of 3.1 during this year.
